name: tia_get_technology_object_parameters
description: Read the parameters of one technology object by their 'Name in Openness' (TechnologicalInstanceDB.Parameters), with each current value as invariant text and its CLR type. Use this before tia_set_technology_object_parameters to learn the exact names and types, which differ per object type and version (e.g. PID_Temp V1.1 on S7-1200 has no Config.ActivateHeating; that exists from V2.0).

filter.description: Optional case-sensitive name prefix, e.g. 'Config.' or 'Retain.CtrlParams.'.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name (case-sensitive); required when the project has multiple PLCs.
